content: The extensive data obtained through real-time continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) enables a thorough and detailed analysis of diabetes management by identifying and tracking trends in glucose levels over extended periods. Utilizing CGM data effectively can lead to improved clinical outcomes by offering precise insights into the patterns and frequency of hyperglycemia and hypoglycemia, allowing for targeted interventions. Recent guidelines highlight the critical need for standardized methodologies in interpreting CGM data to facilitate prompt and informed clinical decision-making, as well as timely adjustments to therapeutic regimens.
